query: Consider the following context: High entropy alloys have excellent wear resistance, so they have great application prospects in the fields of wear resistance and surface protection. In that context, which material can be used for adhere to the surface of a Cu matrix, and why?

generation.hypothesis: AlCrFeNiV high-entropy alloy can be used to adhere to the surface of a Cu matrix due to its high hardness and wear resistance.
generation.intervention: Adhering AlCrFeNiV high-entropy alloy to the surface
generation.conditions: High-entropy alloy with high hardness and wear resistance
generation.mechanism: The high hardness and wear resistance of the alloy improve its ability to adhere to the Cu matrix
generation.predicted_outcome: Improved wear resistance and surface protection of the Cu matrix
generation.baseline: Cu matrix without high-entropy alloy coating
generation.boundary: The high-entropy alloy must be properly adhered to the Cu matrix to achieve improved wear resistance
generation.uncertainty: The exact mechanism of how the high-entropy alloy improves wear resistance is not fully understood

falsification_experiment.design: Compare the wear resistance of a Cu matrix with and without AlCrFeNiV high-entropy alloy coating
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the wear rate of the Cu matrix with AlCrFeNiV high-entropy alloy coating is not significantly lower than that of the Cu matrix without coating, then the hypothesis is falsified
